note: Real, dated export shipments are confirmed from Indian customs records: Nhava Sheva (INNSA1) to Poland (Gdansk, Gdynia) and Germany (Hamburg), Feb 2026, with HS 62046290, 61091000, 62114390, 62063090 and B/L numbers 1108615, 1066980, 1058185, 1023858, 9958770. Buyers are EU apparel retailers/importers (LPP S.A, SMYK, Bon Prix, Josef Witt). Declared HS set 620342/620442/620462/620630 is broadly consistent with observed 62046290 and 62063090, but observed records also include 61091000 (knitted T-shirts) and 62114390 (polyester ladies tunic) which fall outside the declared list — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the factual HS range should be widened to include 6109 and 6211. Note the declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) contradicts the shipment evidence, which is 100% readymade garments (woven/knitted cotton and polyester apparel); the industry field should be corrected to textiles/apparel. Domestic Indian-market supply is unverified (see domestic_evidence). No revenue or export-volume figure is public in the free view, so those fields are null rather than estimated.
